headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The American League All-Stars dominated the National League All-Stars in the Midsummer Classic, winning 4-0. Miguel Vargas led the offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Washington Nationals placed catcher Drew Millas on the 10-day injured list due to a left index finger fracture.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Drew Millas (Washington Nationals) is out with a left index finger fracture, while Nick Mears (Kansas City Royals) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement. Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles) has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow discomfort.

The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their outfield, acquiring outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade. The details of the trade, which was announced on July 14, 2026, include the Red Sox receiving Jones in exchange for a player to be named later. Other notable trades include the Kansas City Royals acquiring Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash and the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.
